title: Zesty Bouncy Greek Beef Stifado
description: A kid-friendly Greek dish featuring worcestershire sauce, this stifado is a flavorful and bouncy beef stew with a grassy twist, suitable for ayurvedic tamasic diets.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic to the pot and cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the worcestershire sauce, tomato paste, salt, and pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in the chopped parsley and serve hot.
Serve with crusty bread or over rice.
Let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
